note: Staged Hot Pursuit scenes (roadmap WP 8.1 and 8.2, L4; DECISIONS D930, D950). Each is drawn by the JS game's own PursuitView.js (on a stand-in race: the level's track, a player Vehicle, an Effects, the seeded pursuit and police streams of src/parity/sim.js) in a fly-camera station of the level, and by the Rust client's play::police and play::fx with ?pv=<name>, from the same data: tools/parity/pursuit-scenes.mjs. Units are pursuit.units by index (0-2 patrol cars, 3-4 interceptors, 5-6 SUVs), placed with pursuit.activate(u, s, lat, speed, mode, dir) and given their siren; roadblock and spikes are placeRoadblock(s) and placeSpikes(s). Each frame, PursuitView's clock is t + frame x dt, the events due are pushed, then pv.sync(dt, night, lightsOn) and effects.update(dt, night, extras). Math.random is mulberry32(seed) for the frames on both sides.

scenes.name: units-red
scenes.what: Three units on the player's tail at blue hour, seen from ahead, the sirens in a red burst: lenses, glow billboards, the shared red light on the road and the player's car, the units' headlight pools

scenes.name: units-blue
scenes.what: The same units a moment later, in a blue burst

scenes.name: steady
scenes.what: Police lights flash off: the sirens glow steady red and blue, and there is no shared light

scenes.name: far
scenes.what: Units 120 to 300 m off: their far models, and the glows held at their minimum size with a harder core

scenes.name: day
scenes.what: By day on Sierra: the glows dimmed to 0.3, the light at a quarter, no pools

scenes.name: roadblock
scenes.what: A heavy roadblock (heat 5): cars across the road with their lights going, the gap closed by two sawhorses

scenes.name: barrier-close
scenes.what: The heavy roadblock up close: the sawhorses' striped canvas boards and A-frame legs in the gap, the cars' lenses and glows beside them

scenes.name: spikes
scenes.what: A spike strip across the player's half of the road, the unit that laid it on the far shoulder, and a third of a second of sparks off the player's spiked rims

scenes.name: spikes-close
scenes.what: The spike strip from just behind it, looking down: its dark base and two rows of steel pyramids across the player's half of the road

scenes.name: damage
scenes.what: A second of smoke: from under the player's bonnet at 95 % damage, from a disabled unit (its siren dim red), and a u-turn's two puffs
